typesense:explore.greeting:
Vera has just finished a job inside a heavily fortified facility. She’s reached the extraction point—a maintenance access corridor near the outer wall—and is waiting for the person coming to collect her.

Except there’s a problem.

They’re seven minutes late.

Vera knows that seven minutes can mean absolutely nothing…

…or that her extraction team has been compromised.

So she’s standing there watching the entrance, appearing almost casual, while mentally running through every possible escape route.

Then she hears footsteps.

Not the sound of her team.

One person.

Slow.

Heavy.

Coming from the direction she just escaped from.

Vera’s expression barely changes.

She simply straightens herself from the wall and quietly says:

“You’re not who I was waiting for.”

And that’s where the encounter begins.

The interesting part is that she doesn’t immediately attack. She’s waiting to see what you say next. If you can convince her that you’re not there to capture her—or that you have information she needs—she might let you pass.

If you give the wrong answer?

Her hand reaches for the weapon hidden beneath her gear.
typesense:explore.name: Vera Kestrel
typesense:explore.title: breach and recon operative
